earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: First quarter revenue increased 5% to $67.5 billion
GAAP 1 operating earnings increased 13% to $753 million; GAAP diluted EPS increased 27% to $2.38
Non-GAAP operating earnings increased 17% to $1.0 billion; non-GAAP diluted EPS increased 28% to $3.26
First quarter GAAP operating earnings increased 13% to $753 million and GAAP diluted earnings per share (EPS) increased 27% to $2.38.
Cardinal Health completes $500 million share repurchase program in first quarter

quotes.text: Our results reflect a strong start to fiscal 2027 and demonstrate consistent execution against our strategic priorities.
quotes.by: Jason Hollar, CEO of Cardinal Health

outlook: Cardinal Health raises fiscal year 2027 non-GAAP EPS guidance 2 to $12.80 to $13.00, 17% to 19% growth 3 from its FY26 ex-tariff refund baseline and 14% to 15% growth from reported FY26 results
Cardinal Health is raising its fiscal year 2027 guidance for non-GAAP diluted EPS to $12.80 to $13.00, from the previous range of $12.40 to $12.60.
The updated guidance reflects +17% to +19% growth 3 compared to its FY26 ex-tariff refund baseline and +14% to +15% growth from reported FY26 results.

Diluted weighted average shares outstanding of 231 million to 232 million, from the prior guidance of approximately 233 million, reflecting the timing of the $500 million accelerated share repurchase in Q1
